blocks.zh: Definition & Materials 定義與材料
blocks.en: Definition & Materials

blocks.zh: 定義 Definition
blocks.en: Definition

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 單次使用（Single-Use）：明確禁止重複滅菌或重複使用。這不只是製造標準，也是病患安全的核心要求——再次使用可能導致殘留藥物交叉汙染、機械性能退化及無菌保證失效。
blocks.en: Single-use: Re-sterilisation and re-use are expressly prohibited. This is not only a manufacturing standard but a core patient-safety requirement: re-use can lead to cross-contamination from residual drug, degraded mechanical performance, and loss of sterility assurance.

blocks.zh: 醫療器材（Medical Device）：注射器在 EU MDR 2017/745 框架下被分類為 Class IIa 醫療器材，因此需符合 CE 標誌要求及 MDR 技術文件。Ph.Eur. 3.3.8 為其藥典品質要求。
blocks.en: Medical device: Under the EU MDR 2017/745 framework, syringes are classified as Class IIa medical devices, so they must meet CE marking requirements and have MDR technical documentation. Ph.Eur. 3.3.8 provides the pharmacopoeial quality requirements for them.

blocks.zh: 材料選擇：聚丙烯（PP）為最常用，具良好化學惰性、透明度及可高壓滅菌性。部分預充式注射器使用環烯烴共聚物（COC/COP）以提高阻隔性。
blocks.en: Material selection: Polypropylene (PP) is the most common, with good chemical inertness, transparency, and autoclavability. Some prefilled syringes use cyclic olefin copolymer (COC/COP) for better barrier properties.

blocks.zh: GMP 重點提示
blocks.en: GMP Key Point

blocks.zh: 「個別保護維持無菌」（individual protection for maintaining sterility）意味著每支注射器必須有獨立的初級包裝（primary packaging），開封即代表無菌狀態終止——這是容器密封完整性（Container Closure Integrity, CCI）測試的基礎要求。
blocks.en: "Individual protection for maintaining sterility" means that every syringe must have its own primary packaging; once the pack is opened, the sterile state is considered ended. This is the basic requirement behind container closure integrity (CCI) testing.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 注射器的透明度要求就像玻璃瓶：你要能清楚看到藥液劑量刻度、氣泡及任何異物。這不只是使用方便，也是最終目視檢查（100% Visual Inspection）的基礎——看不清楚的注射器等同於不合格的包裝。
blocks.en: The transparency requirement for a syringe is like that for a glass vial: you must be able to see the dose graduations, air bubbles, and any foreign matter clearly. This is not just a convenience; it is the basis of final 100% visual inspection. A syringe you cannot see through is equivalent to non-conforming packaging.

blocks.zh: 材料要求 Material Requirements
blocks.en: Material Requirements

blocks.zh: 矽油的雙重角色 Dual Role of Silicone Oil
blocks.en: Dual Role of Silicone Oil

blocks.zh: 矽油（Silicone Oil / PDMS, polydimethylsiloxane）是注射器內壁的必要潤滑劑，可降低活塞滑動阻力（Glide Force），確保注射推力均勻。但它同時也是一個關鍵品質屬性（CQA）：
blocks.en: Silicone oil (PDMS, polydimethylsiloxane) is the essential lubricant on the inner barrel wall: it lowers the plunger glide force and ensures a uniform injection force. But it is also a critical quality attribute (CQA):

blocks.zh: 問題：矽油微滴（silicone oil droplets）可能引發蛋白質藥物（如單株抗體 mAb）聚集，形成可見或次可見微粒（visible / subvisible particles）
blocks.en: Issue: Silicone oil droplets can trigger aggregation of protein drugs (such as monoclonal antibodies, mAb), forming visible or subvisible particles.

blocks.zh: 限量：Ph.Eur. 3.3.8 規定 ≤0.25 mg/cm² 內表面積
blocks.en: Limit: Ph.Eur. 3.3.8 specifies ≤0.25 mg/cm² of inner surface area.

blocks.zh: 稽核焦點：矽油用量的工藝控制記錄、跨批次一致性
blocks.en: Audit focus: Process control records for the amount of silicone oil applied, and batch-to-batch consistency.

blocks.zh: 油墨遷移要求 Ink Migration
blocks.en: Ink Migration

blocks.zh: 「油墨不得穿透筒壁遷移」——這是針對劑量刻度印刷（scale markings）的要求。在稽核中，需要提供油墨遷移測試數據或供應商材料合規聲明（Supplier Declaration of Conformity）。
blocks.en: "Ink must not migrate through the barrel wall." This requirement applies to the printed dose scale markings. In an audit, you need to provide ink migration test data or a supplier declaration of conformity.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 對於預充式注射器（Prefilled Syringe, PFS）製造商而言，矽油塗布工藝（Siliconization Process）是一個關鍵製程控制點。過量矽油會增加微粒風險；不足則導致推力過大，影響病患安全。必須建立矽油用量的 Design Space。
blocks.en: For prefilled syringe (PFS) manufacturers, the siliconisation process is a critical process control point. Excess silicone oil increases the particle risk; too little causes excessive glide force and affects patient safety. A design space for the amount of silicone oil must be established.

blocks.zh: Solution S Preparation 溶液S的製備
blocks.en: Solution S Preparation

blocks.zh: Reference Solution for Chemical Tests | 化學測試標準溶液
blocks.en: Reference Solution for Chemical Tests

blocks.zh: 關鍵參數摘要 Key Parameters
blocks.en: Key Parameters

blocks.zh: Solution S 的科學設計邏輯
blocks.en: Scientific Logic Behind the Design of Solution S

blocks.zh: 為何是 37°C / 24 h？這模擬的是注射器在儲存或使用前，藥液與塑膠材料接觸的最壞條件（Worst Case）。37°C 約等於人體體溫，代表可能的最高使用溫度。
blocks.en: Why 37°C / 24 h? This simulates the worst case for contact between the drug solution and the plastic before storage or use. 37°C is roughly body temperature and represents the highest likely use temperature.

blocks.zh: 為何用 Water R？水是極性溶劑，可萃取出水溶性可萃取物（Extractables）。使用純化水（Purified Water）而非注射用水，是因為本測試為材料性能測試，非最終產品放行測試。
blocks.en: Why Water R? Water is a polar solvent and extracts water-soluble extractables. Purified water is used instead of water for injections because this is a material performance test, not a final product release test.

blocks.zh: 硼矽酸鹽玻璃容器：化學惰性，不會引入額外的可萃取物或干擾後續測試。
blocks.en: Borosilicate glass container: It is chemically inert and does not introduce additional extractables or interfere with subsequent tests.

blocks.zh: Solution S 就像是「注射器的汗水測試」——把注射器泡在體溫熱水中一整天，收集所有滲出的物質，然後分析這些物質是否安全。這是萃取物（Extractables）研究的簡化版本，適用於藥典常規放行測試。
blocks.en: Solution S is like a "sweat test for the syringe": soak the syringe in body-temperature water for a full day, collect everything that leaches out, and then analyse whether those substances are safe. It is a simplified version of an extractables study and is suitable for routine pharmacopoeial release testing.

blocks.zh: GMP 操作要點
blocks.en: GMP Operating Points

blocks.zh: 製備 Solution S 時需要特別防止異物汙染（foreign particles）——這在潔淨室（Cleanroom）或層流罩（LAF）內操作尤為重要。汙染的 Solution S 會導致外觀測試（Appearance）及透明度測試（Transparency）假陽性失敗。
blocks.en: Foreign particle contamination must be specifically prevented when preparing Solution S, which is especially important inside a cleanroom or laminar air flow (LAF) cabinet. Contaminated Solution S will cause false failures in the appearance and transparency tests.

blocks.zh: Chemical Tests 化學測試
blocks.en: Chemical Tests

blocks.zh: Appearance, Acidity/Alkalinity, Absorbance, Reducing Substances | 外觀、酸鹼度、吸光度、還原物質
blocks.en: Appearance, Acidity/Alkalinity, Absorbance, Reducing Substances

blocks.zh: 外觀 Appearance of Solution
blocks.en: Appearance of Solution

blocks.zh: 判定標準解析
blocks.en: Interpretation of the Criteria

blocks.zh: Clear (2.2.1)：參照歐洲藥典澄清度標準（Reference suspension I 或更佳），用比色管在自然光下目視比較。
blocks.en: Clear (2.2.1): Refer to the European Pharmacopoeia clarity standard (Reference suspension I or better), comparing visually in natural light using colourimetric tubes.

blocks.zh: Colourless (2.2.2, Method II)：與 BY7 參考液（黃色基準）比較，溶液不得有可見色澤。
blocks.en: Colourless (2.2.2, Method II): Compared with the BY7 reference solution (yellow standard); the solution must show no visible colour.

blocks.zh: Practically free from foreign solid particles：除肉眼可見微粒外，亦考量次可見微粒的背景水平。
blocks.en: Practically free from foreign solid particles: Besides particles visible to the naked eye, the background level of subvisible particles is also considered.

blocks.zh: 判定準則 Acceptance Criteria
blocks.en: Acceptance Criteria

blocks.zh: Solution S 必須：
blocks.en: Solution S must be:

blocks.zh: 澄清（Clear）
blocks.en: Clear

blocks.zh: 無色（Colourless）
blocks.en: Colourless

blocks.zh: 幾乎不含外來固體微粒（practically free from foreign solid particles）
blocks.en: Practically free from foreign solid particles

blocks.zh: 酸性或鹼性 Acidity or Alkalinity
blocks.en: Acidity or Alkalinity

blocks.zh: 限量 Limit
blocks.en: Limit

blocks.zh: 測試原理解析
blocks.en: Principle of the Test

blocks.zh: 溴百里酚藍（Bromothymol Blue, BTB）：pH 6.0（黃色）至 7.6（藍色）的指示劑。這個測試評估注射器材料是否對萃取液造成顯著的 pH 偏移。
blocks.en: Bromothymol blue (BTB): An indicator that changes from yellow at pH 6.0 to blue at pH 7.6. This test evaluates whether the syringe material causes a significant pH shift in the extract.

blocks.zh: 0.3 mL × 0.01 M = 0.003 meq 的酸或鹼——這是非常嚴格的限量，表示材料對 pH 的影響必須極小。
blocks.en: 0.3 mL × 0.01 M = 0.003 meq of acid or base. This is a very strict limit, meaning the effect of the material on pH must be minimal.

blocks.zh: GMP 意義
blocks.en: GMP Significance

blocks.zh: pH 偏移可能影響注射劑的穩定性，特別是蛋白質藥物（Biologics）。聚丙烯材料本身為惰性，但添加劑（antioxidants, stabilisers）可能溶出並影響 pH。此測試確認材料製造符合規格。
blocks.en: A pH shift can affect the stability of an injectable, especially a protein drug (biologic). Polypropylene itself is inert, but additives (antioxidants, stabilisers) can leach out and affect pH. This test confirms that the material is manufactured to specification.

blocks.zh: 吸光度 Absorbance
blocks.en: Absorbance

blocks.zh: UV 吸光度測試的意義
blocks.en: Significance of the UV Absorbance Test

blocks.zh: 220–360 nm 為紫外線範圍：大多數有機化合物（包括塑膠添加劑、抗氧化劑、光穩定劑）在此波段有吸收。高吸光度表示萃取液中存在有機溶出物。
blocks.en: 220–360 nm is the ultraviolet range: Most organic compounds (including plastic additives, antioxidants, and light stabilisers) absorb in this band. High absorbance indicates the presence of organic leachables in the extract.

blocks.zh: 最大吸光度 0.40 是一個相對寬鬆的限量，允許材料有合理程度的溶出。關鍵在於通過測試，而非追求最低值。
blocks.en: A maximum absorbance of 0.40 is a relatively generous limit that allows a reasonable degree of leaching from the material. The point is to pass the test, not to chase the lowest value.

blocks.zh: 與 E&L 研究的關係
blocks.en: Relationship with E&L Studies

blocks.zh: 本測試是常規放行測試（Routine Release Test）。對於高風險藥品（如蛋白質注射劑、高濃度藥物），還需要進行全面的可萃取物 / 可浸出物研究（E&L Study），根據 ISO 10993 或 USP 〈661〉進行更廣泛的化學表徵。
blocks.en: This test is a routine release test. For high-risk drug products (such as protein injectables and high-concentration drugs), a full extractables / leachables (E&L) study is also needed, with broader chemical characterisation according to ISO 10993 or USP <661>.

blocks.zh: 還原物質 Reducing Substances
blocks.en: Reducing Substances

blocks.zh: 還原物質測試原理
blocks.en: Principle of the Reducing Substances Test

blocks.zh: 高錳酸鉀返滴定法（Back-titration with KMnO₄）：
blocks.en: Back-titration with KMnO₄:

blocks.zh: KMnO₄（強氧化劑）與萃取液中的還原性物質反應，KMnO₄被消耗
blocks.en: KMnO₄ (a strong oxidant) reacts with reducing substances in the extract, and the KMnO₄ is consumed

blocks.zh: 剩餘 KMnO₄ 將 KI 氧化為 I₂
blocks.en: The remaining KMnO₄ oxidises KI to I₂

blocks.zh: I₂ 以硫代硫酸鈉滴定（澱粉為指示劑）
blocks.en: The I₂ is titrated with sodium thiosulfate (starch as indicator)

blocks.zh: 樣品 vs 空白差值 = 被還原物質消耗的 KMnO₄ 量
blocks.en: Difference between sample and blank = amount of KMnO₄ consumed by the reducing substances

blocks.zh: 還原物質主要來自塑膠抗氧化劑（如 BHT, Irganox 系列）。這些物質溶出到藥液中可能影響活性成分（API）的穩定性，或對注射用途產生毒理學風險。
blocks.en: Reducing substances come mainly from plastic antioxidants (such as BHT and the Irganox series). When these leach into the drug solution, they may affect the stability of the active ingredient (API) or pose a toxicological risk for injectable use.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 這個測試像「食品新鮮度檢驗」——用強氧化劑「燒掉」所有會腐化的物質，量測消耗量就知道材料釋放了多少「腐敗因子」（還原性溶出物）。差值 ≤3.0 mL 意味著材料夠乾淨。
blocks.en: This test is like a "food freshness check": a strong oxidant "burns off" everything that can spoil, and the amount consumed tells you how many "spoilage agents" (reducing leachables) the material released. A difference of ≤3.0 mL means the material is clean enough.

blocks.en: Ethylene Oxide Testing

blocks.en: Head-space GC-MS Method (2.2.28 + 2.2.43)

blocks.zh: 關鍵限量 Key Limit — EtO Residuals
blocks.en: Key Limit — EtO Residuals

blocks.zh: 樣品製備 Sample Preparation
blocks.en: Sample Preparation

blocks.zh: 樣品製備的關鍵考量
blocks.en: Key Considerations in Sample Preparation

blocks.zh: 研磨成細顆粒：增加表面積，確保 EtO 完全從基質中釋放至頂空（headspace）。粒徑越小，萃取效率越高。
blocks.en: Grinding to fine particles: This increases surface area and ensures that EtO is fully released from the matrix into the headspace. The smaller the particle size, the higher the extraction efficiency.

blocks.zh: 樣品量 0.10–3.00 g：取決於預期 EtO 濃度。高殘留樣品用少量（避免超出偵測範圍）；低殘留用大量（提高靈敏度）。
blocks.en: Sample amount 0.10–3.00 g: This depends on the expected EtO concentration. Use a small amount for high-residue samples (to avoid exceeding the detection range) and a larger amount for low-residue samples (to increase sensitivity).

blocks.zh: 低釋放材料的熱萃取（120°C, ≥15 h）：COC/COP 等緻密材料 EtO 擴散速率低，需要高溫預萃取確保 EtO 完全釋放至頂空，否則會低估殘留量。
blocks.en: Thermal extraction for low-release materials (120°C, ≥15 h): In dense materials such as COC/COP, EtO diffuses slowly, so high-temperature pre-extraction is needed to ensure complete release of EtO into the headspace; otherwise the residue will be underestimated.

blocks.zh: 乙醛（Acetaldehyde）的作用
blocks.en: Role of Acetaldehyde

blocks.zh: Reference solution j 含乙醛作為系統適用性測試用——EtO 與乙醛在 GC 上的峰必須達到分離度 ≥1.5，確認色譜系統能分離兩個化合物，避免干擾定量。
blocks.en: Reference solution j contains acetaldehyde for the system suitability test: the EtO and acetaldehyde peaks on the GC must achieve a resolution ≥1.5, confirming that the chromatographic system can separate the two compounds and avoiding interference with quantitation.

blocks.zh: 色譜條件 Chromatographic Conditions
blocks.en: Chromatographic Conditions

blocks.zh: MS SIM 模式的優勢 Advantages of SIM Mode
blocks.en: Advantages of SIM Mode

blocks.zh: 選擇性離子監測（Selected Ion Monitoring, SIM）：
blocks.en: Selected Ion Monitoring (SIM):

blocks.zh: 只監測特定 m/z 值，大幅提高靈敏度和選擇性：
blocks.en: Monitoring only specific m/z values greatly improves sensitivity and selectivity:

blocks.zh: m/z = 44：EtO 的分子離子（Molecular Ion），用於定量（Quantitation）
blocks.en: m/z = 44: The molecular ion of EtO, used for quantitation

blocks.zh: m/z = 29：CHO⁺ 碎片（Fragment Ion），用於確認（Qualification）
blocks.en: m/z = 29: The CHO⁺ fragment ion, used for qualification (confirmation)

blocks.zh: m/z = 15：CH₃⁺ 碎片，進一步確認 EtO 身份
blocks.en: m/z = 15: The CH₃⁺ fragment, providing further confirmation of EtO identity

blocks.zh: 三個離子比例（Ion Ratio）需符合容許範圍，防止假陽性。
blocks.en: The ratios of the three ions (ion ratio) must fall within the permitted range to prevent false positives.

blocks.zh: SIM 模式就像「DNA 指紋鑑定」——不只看外形（m/z=44），還要確認 DNA 的其他標記（m/z=29, 15）都吻合，才能確認是「真正的」EtO，而非其他分子量相近的化合物干擾。
blocks.en: SIM mode is like "DNA fingerprinting": you do not only look at the outline (m/z = 44) but also confirm that the other DNA markers (m/z = 29, 15) all match, so you can be sure it is "genuine" EtO and not interference from another compound of similar molecular weight.

blocks.zh: 系統適用性 System Suitability
blocks.en: System Suitability

blocks.zh: 系統適用性測試的邏輯
blocks.en: Logic of the System Suitability Test

blocks.zh: Rs ≥ 1.5：確保 EtO 與乙醛基線分離，排除乙醛對 EtO 定量的干擾。若分離度不足，EtO 峰面積可能被高估。
blocks.en: Rs ≥ 1.5: Ensures baseline separation of EtO from acetaldehyde, ruling out interference from acetaldehyde in EtO quantitation. If the resolution is insufficient, the EtO peak area may be overestimated.

blocks.zh: S/N ≥ 10 at lowest standard：確認方法靈敏度足以偵測接近限量（10 ppm）的 EtO 濃度。S/N ≥10 是定量下限（LOQ）的標準判定準則。
blocks.en: S/N ≥ 10 at lowest standard: Confirms that the method is sensitive enough to detect EtO at concentrations near the limit (10 ppm). S/N ≥ 10 is the standard criterion for the limit of quantitation (LOQ).

blocks.zh: 稽核準備要點 Audit Preparation
blocks.en: Audit Preparation

blocks.zh: 稽核人員可能要求：
blocks.en: An auditor may ask for:

blocks.zh: SST（System Suitability Test）記錄，含 Rs 及 S/N 計算值
blocks.en: SST (system suitability test) records, including the calculated Rs and S/N values

blocks.zh: 校正曲線（Calibration Curve）及線性範圍（r² 值）
blocks.en: Calibration curve and linear range (r² value)

blocks.zh: 方法確認（Method Validation）報告（準確度、精密度、線性、偵測限、定量限）
blocks.en: Method validation report (accuracy, precision, linearity, detection limit, quantitation limit)

blocks.zh: 分析師訓練記錄
blocks.en: Analyst training records

blocks.en: EtO Testing Decision Tree

blocks.zh: 何時需要做 EtO 測試？ When is EtO Testing Required?
blocks.en: When is EtO Testing Required?

blocks.en: Testing Required

blocks.zh: 標示上聲明以 EtO 滅菌
blocks.en: The label declares EtO sterilisation

blocks.en: Testing Not Required

blocks.en: Other sterilisation methods are used (radiation, steam, filtration)

blocks.zh: Silicone Oil Testing 矽油測試
blocks.en: Silicone Oil Testing

blocks.zh: Extraction Method & Acceptance Limit | 萃取方法與限量要求 (Ph.Eur. 3.1.8)
blocks.en: Extraction Method & Acceptance Limit (Ph.Eur. 3.1.8)

blocks.zh: 關鍵限量 Key Limit — Silicone Oil
blocks.en: Key Limit — Silicone Oil

blocks.zh: 內表面積計算 Internal Surface Area Calculation
blocks.en: Internal Surface Area Calculation

blocks.zh: 計算公式 Calculation Formula
blocks.en: Calculation Formula

blocks.zh: 為何以「面積」而非「重量」或「體積」計算？
blocks.en: Why calculate by "area" rather than by "weight" or "volume"?

blocks.zh: 矽油均勻塗布於注射筒內壁表面，其用量本質上是一個表面覆蓋量（Surface Coverage）。以 mg/cm² 表示：
blocks.en: Silicone oil is applied uniformly on the inner barrel wall surface, so the amount used is essentially a surface coverage. It is expressed in mg/cm²:

blocks.zh: 可跨不同容量注射器（1 mL, 5 mL, 10 mL, 20 mL）標準化比較
blocks.en: It allows standardised comparison across syringes of different capacities (1 mL, 5 mL, 10 mL, 20 mL)

blocks.zh: 與矽油塗布工藝的噴塗量直接對應
blocks.en: It corresponds directly to the spray amount in the siliconisation process

blocks.zh: 可換算為每支注射器的總矽油量（mg/syringe = mg/cm² × A）
blocks.en: It can be converted to the total silicone oil per syringe (mg/syringe = mg/cm² × A)

blocks.zh: 就像計算油漆用量——不管你要粉刷大房間還是小房間，都是用「每平方公尺需要幾公升油漆」來標準化，而不是「整間房子總共用了幾公升」。矽油的表面覆蓋量概念完全相同。
blocks.en: It is like calculating paint usage: whether you are painting a large room or a small one, you standardise as "litres of paint per square metre" rather than "total litres used for the whole house". The concept of silicone oil surface coverage is exactly the same.

blocks.zh: 萃取方法 Extraction Method
blocks.en: Extraction Method

blocks.zh: 操作摘要 Procedure Summary
blocks.en: Procedure Summary

blocks.zh: 二氯甲烷（DCM）萃取的科學邏輯
blocks.en: Scientific Logic of Methylene Chloride (DCM) Extraction

blocks.zh: Methylene Chloride (DCM, CH₂Cl₂)：矽油（聚二甲基矽氧烷, PDMS）在非極性有機溶劑中溶解度高，DCM 是理想的萃取溶劑。
blocks.en: Methylene Chloride (DCM, CH₂Cl₂): Silicone oil (polydimethylsiloxane, PDMS) is highly soluble in non-polar organic solvents, making DCM an ideal extraction solvent.

blocks.zh: 倒置 10 次：確保 DCM 與整個注射筒內壁充分接觸，提高萃取效率。
blocks.en: Inverting 10 times: Ensures that the DCM contacts the whole inner barrel wall thoroughly, improving extraction efficiency.

blocks.zh: 兩次萃取：First extraction removes majority of silicone; second extraction confirms complete removal (recovery check).
blocks.en: Two extractions: First extraction removes majority of silicone; second extraction confirms complete removal (recovery check).

blocks.zh: IR 確認的重要性
blocks.en: Importance of IR Confirmation

blocks.zh: 蒸發殘留物的稱重只能得到「總量」，IR 光譜確認殘留物確實是矽油（PDMS 特徵峰：Si-O-Si 伸縮振動 ~1000–1100 cm⁻¹，Si-CH₃ 彎曲 ~1260 cm⁻¹），排除其他非矽油殘留物干擾稱重。
blocks.en: Weighing the evaporation residue gives only the "total amount". IR spectroscopy confirms that the residue is indeed silicone oil (PDMS characteristic peaks: Si-O-Si stretching ~1000–1100 cm⁻¹, Si-CH₃ bending ~1260 cm⁻¹), ruling out other non-silicone residues that would interfere with the weighing.

blocks.zh: 預充式注射器 PFS 的特殊考量
blocks.en: Special Considerations for Prefilled Syringes (PFS)

blocks.zh: 矽油在 PFS 的特殊挑戰：矽油微滴（Silicone Droplets）可能：
blocks.en: The particular challenge of silicone oil in PFS: silicone droplets may:

blocks.zh: 引起蛋白質藥物（mAb, fusion protein）聚集
blocks.en: Cause aggregation of protein drugs (mAb, fusion protein)

blocks.zh: 在 USP 〈787〉/〈788〉次可見微粒（Subvisible Particles）測試中呈現
blocks.en: Appear in USP <787>/<788> subvisible particle testing

blocks.zh: 觸發 FDA 的 OOS/OOT 調查
blocks.en: Trigger FDA OOS/OOT investigations

blocks.zh: 解決方案：Baked-on silicone（烘烤固化矽油）或 Cross-linked silicone coating（交聯矽油塗層）可減少矽油遷移。
blocks.en: Solution: Baked-on silicone or cross-linked silicone coating can reduce silicone migration.

blocks.zh: Biological Tests 生物測試
blocks.en: Biological Tests

blocks.zh: Transparency, Sterility, Bacterial Endotoxins, Pyrogens | 透明度、無菌性、細菌內毒素、熱原
blocks.en: Transparency, Sterility, Bacterial Endotoxins, Pyrogens

blocks.zh: 透明度 Transparency
blocks.en: Transparency

blocks.zh: 判定準則
blocks.en: Acceptance Criteria

blocks.zh: 注射筒透明度須足以在漫射光 / 暗背景下，肉眼辨識：
blocks.en: The syringe barrel must be transparent enough that, in diffuse light against a dark background, the naked eye can distinguish:

blocks.zh: 劑量刻度 (dosage markings)
blocks.en: Dosage markings

blocks.zh: 氣泡 (air bubbles)
blocks.en: Air bubbles

blocks.zh: 外來微粒 (foreign particles)
blocks.en: Foreign particles

blocks.zh: 乳光懸浮液（10倍稀釋）可見
blocks.en: The primary opalescent suspension (diluted 10 times) is visible

blocks.zh: 透明度測試的設計邏輯
blocks.en: Design Logic of the Transparency Test

blocks.zh: 使用 10 倍稀釋的初級乳光懸浮液作為陽性對照（Positive Control）——若注射筒在漫射光下無法辨識此懸浮液的乳光，表示材料透明度不足，無法滿足目視檢查需求。
blocks.en: A primary opalescent suspension diluted 10 times is used as the positive control: if the opalescence of this suspension cannot be distinguished through the syringe in diffuse light, the material is not transparent enough to meet visual inspection needs.

blocks.zh: 漫射光 + 暗背景：模擬臨床使用前的目視查驗條件，確保醫護人員能在一般診療環境中發現異常。
blocks.en: Diffuse light + dark background: Simulates the visual check conditions before clinical use, ensuring that healthcare staff can spot abnormalities in an ordinary clinical setting.

blocks.zh: 連結目視檢查（100% VI）
blocks.en: Link to Visual Inspection (100% VI)

blocks.zh: 注射器的透明度直接影響 100% 目視檢查的可行性。若使用不透明或半透明材料（如某些著色 PP），則需提供替代性 CCI 測試方案，並獲得主管機關同意。
blocks.en: Syringe transparency directly affects the feasibility of 100% visual inspection. If opaque or translucent materials are used (such as some coloured PP), an alternative CCI testing approach must be provided and agreed with the competent authority.

blocks.zh: 無菌性測試 Sterility (2.6.1)
blocks.en: Sterility (2.6.1)

blocks.zh: No microbial growth detected after incubation 培養期後無微生物生長
blocks.en: No microbial growth detected after incubation

blocks.zh: 膜過濾 vs 直接接種
blocks.en: Membrane Filtration vs Direct Inoculation

blocks.zh: 膜過濾法（首選）：適用於大容量樣品，可過濾更多液體，統計靈敏度更高。需確認膜過濾不影響微生物存活（Bacteriostasis/Fungistasis test）。
blocks.en: Membrane filtration (preferred): Suitable for large-volume samples; more liquid can be filtered, giving higher statistical sensitivity. It must be confirmed that membrane filtration does not affect microbial survival (bacteriostasis/fungistasis test).

blocks.zh: 直接接種法：適用於無法膜過濾的情況（如高粘度藥液、油性製品）。
blocks.en: Direct inoculation: Suitable where membrane filtration is not possible (such as highly viscous solutions and oily products).

blocks.zh: 細菌內毒素 Bacterial Endotoxins (2.6.14)
blocks.en: Bacterial Endotoxins (2.6.14)

blocks.zh: 關鍵限量
blocks.en: Key Limit

blocks.zh: 內毒素限量的設定依據
blocks.en: Basis for Setting the Endotoxin Limit

blocks.zh: 0.5 IU/mL：此限量基於注射器作為藥液接觸容器的最壞使用條件。對於靜脈注射藥品，內毒素限量通常依 K/M 公式計算：
blocks.en: 0.5 IU/mL: This limit is based on the worst-case use condition of the syringe as a drug-contact container. For intravenous drug products, the endotoxin limit is usually calculated with the K/M formula:

blocks.zh: LAL 測試（鱟試劑）方法選擇
blocks.en: Choice of LAL (Limulus Amebocyte Lysate) Test Method

blocks.zh: Ph.Eur. 2.6.14 允許三種 LAL 方法：
blocks.en: Ph.Eur. 2.6.14 allows three LAL methods:

blocks.zh: Gel-clot：半定量，最傳統
blocks.en: Gel-clot: Semi-quantitative, the most traditional

blocks.zh: Turbidimetric：定量，高通量
blocks.en: Turbidimetric: Quantitative, high throughput

blocks.zh: Chromogenic：定量，光學讀值精確
blocks.en: Chromogenic: Quantitative, with precise optical readout

blocks.zh: 現代 CDMO 多採用 chromogenic 或 recombinant Factor C (rFC) 方法，避免鱟試劑供應短缺問題。
blocks.en: Modern CDMOs mostly use chromogenic or recombinant Factor C (rFC) methods to avoid the problem of horseshoe crab lysate supply shortages.

blocks.zh: 熱原試驗 Pyrogens (2.6.8)
blocks.en: Pyrogens (2.6.8)

blocks.zh: 3R 原則與法規趨勢
blocks.en: The 3Rs Principle and Regulatory Trends

blocks.zh: 依 ICH Q4B Annex 14 及歐洲藥典的更新方向，BET（細菌內毒素測試）已被確立為優先方法（Preferred Method），Pyrogen test 僅在 BET 無法適用時才使用。Ph.Eur. 3.3.8 亦依此原則設計。
blocks.en: Following ICH Q4B Annex 14 and the direction of European Pharmacopoeia updates, BET (bacterial endotoxins test) has been established as the preferred method, and the pyrogen test is used only when BET cannot be applied. Ph.Eur. 3.3.8 is designed on this principle.

blocks.zh: Labelling 標示
blocks.en: Labelling

blocks.zh: EtO Sterilisation Declaration & ISO 15223 Symbols | 環氧乙烷滅菌聲明與 ISO 符號
blocks.en: EtO Sterilisation Declaration & ISO 15223 Symbols

blocks.zh: 標示要求觸發條件
blocks.en: Conditions That Trigger the Labelling Requirement

blocks.zh: 只有當注射器採用環氧乙烷（EtO）滅菌時，才需要在標示上聲明。其他滅菌方式（如 Gamma 輻射、電子束 E-beam、蒸汽）有各自的 ISO 符號，但本章只規定 EtO 的聲明義務。
blocks.en: A declaration on the label is required only when the syringe is sterilised with ethylene oxide (EtO). Other sterilisation methods (such as gamma irradiation, electron beam (E-beam), and steam) have their own ISO symbols, but this chapter prescribes the declaration obligation for EtO only.

blocks.zh: EtO 滅菌標示的 GMP 意義
blocks.en: GMP Significance of EtO Sterilisation Labelling

blocks.zh: 聲明 EtO 滅菌的注射器，在藥廠進料驗收（Incoming Inspection）時必須：
blocks.en: For syringes declared as EtO sterilised, the pharmaceutical manufacturer must at incoming inspection:

blocks.zh: 進行 EtO 殘留量測試（或要求供應商 CoA 含 EtO 測試結果）
blocks.en: Perform EtO residue testing (or require the supplier CoA to include EtO test results)

blocks.zh: 確認通氣（Aeration / Degassing）時間已完成，EtO ≤10 ppm
blocks.en: Confirm that the aeration / degassing time has been completed and EtO is ≤10 ppm

blocks.zh: 追蹤 EtO 滅菌批次記錄（Sterilisation Cycle Records）
blocks.en: Track the EtO sterilisation batch records (sterilisation cycle records)

blocks.zh: 標示就是承諾
blocks.en: The Label Is a Commitment

blocks.zh: 在標示上聲明「EtO 滅菌」就像食品標示「含花生成分」——一旦聲明，就必須能提供相對應的測試數據和製程控制記錄作為支撐。若聲明與實際不符，屬於重大 GMP 缺失。
blocks.en: Declaring "EtO sterilised" on the label is like a food label saying "contains peanuts": once declared, you must be able to provide the corresponding test data and process control records to support it. If the declaration does not match reality, it is a major GMP deficiency.

blocks.zh: ISO 15223-1 滅菌方法符號
blocks.en: ISO 15223-1 Sterilisation Method Symbols

blocks.zh: 依 ISO 15223-1（醫療器材—表示醫療器材標籤、標記和提供信息的符號），常用滅菌符號：
blocks.en: According to ISO 15223-1 (Medical devices - Symbols to be used with information to be supplied by the manufacturer), the commonly used sterilisation symbols are:

blocks.en: Sterile Fill-Finish Operations

blocks.en: Why Single-Use Matters in Aseptic Fill-Finish

blocks.zh: 技術背景 Technical Background
blocks.en: Technical Background

blocks.zh: 在無菌充填操作中，注射器作為初級包裝材料（Primary Packaging Component）與藥液直接接觸，其品質直接影響：
blocks.en: In aseptic filling operations, the syringe, as a primary packaging component, is in direct contact with the drug solution, and its quality directly affects:

blocks.zh: 無菌保證（Sterility Assurance）：注射器的無菌性是產品最終無菌的前提
blocks.en: Sterility assurance: The sterility of the syringe is the prerequisite for the sterility of the final product

blocks.zh: 可相容性（Compatibility）：材料與藥液的長期相容性，防止溶出物（Leachables）影響藥物穩定性
blocks.en: Compatibility: Long-term compatibility of the material with the drug solution, preventing leachables from affecting drug stability

blocks.zh: 功能性（Functionality）：推力（Glide Force）均一性直接影響自動充填設備的精確度
blocks.en: Functionality: The uniformity of glide force directly affects the accuracy of automated filling equipment

blocks.zh: 容器密封完整性（CCI）：預充式注射器的針頭密封（Needle Seal）及活塞密封需要 100% 驗證
blocks.en: Container closure integrity (CCI): The needle seal and plunger seal of prefilled syringes require 100% verification

blocks.zh: 「不得重複使用」不只是藥典要求，也是 FDA cGMP 21 CFR 211 及 EU GMP Annex 1 的核心原則之一。
blocks.en: "Not to be re-used" is not only a pharmacopoeial requirement but also one of the core principles of FDA cGMP 21 CFR 211 and EU GMP Annex 1.

blocks.en: The supplier completes EtO residue testing before shipment (end-of-aeration testing)

blocks.zh: CoA 包含 GC-MS 測試報告（批次號、測試日期、結果）
blocks.en: The CoA includes the GC-MS test report (batch number, test date, results)

blocks.en: After receipt, the pharmaceutical manufacturer takes acceptance samples and confirms using the Ph.Eur. 3.3.8 method

blocks.en: If the supplier can provide full-batch testing (100% testing), skip-lot testing may be considered

blocks.zh: 異常結果觸發 OOS 調查及退貨程序（Deviation / NCR）
blocks.en: Abnormal results trigger an OOS investigation and a return procedure (deviation / NCR)

blocks.zh: 科學背景 Scientific Background
blocks.en: Scientific Background

blocks.zh: 矽油對蛋白質藥物的影響
blocks.en: Effects of Silicone Oil on Protein Drugs

blocks.zh: 矽油（PDMS）與蛋白質藥物（Biologics）的交互作用已被廣泛研究。主要風險：
blocks.en: The interaction between silicone oil (PDMS) and protein drugs (biologics) has been widely studied. The main risks are:

blocks.zh: 蛋白質吸附（Protein Adsorption）：矽油-水界面可吸附蛋白質，改變蛋白質高階結構（HOS），觸發聚集
blocks.en: Protein adsorption: The silicone oil-water interface can adsorb proteins, altering protein higher-order structure (HOS) and triggering aggregation

blocks.zh: 次可見微粒（Subvisible Particles）：矽油微滴可成為蛋白質聚集的核（nucleation site）
blocks.en: Subvisible particles: Silicone oil droplets can act as nucleation sites for protein aggregation

blocks.zh: 免疫原性（Immunogenicity）：蛋白質-矽油微粒聚集體可能觸發免疫反應
blocks.en: Immunogenicity: Protein-silicone oil particle aggregates may trigger an immune response

blocks.zh: 控制策略 Control Strategy
blocks.en: Control Strategy

blocks.zh: 矽油 CQA 控制要點
blocks.en: Key Points for Controlling Silicone Oil as a CQA

blocks.zh: 規格設定：依 Ph.Eur. 3.3.8 ≤0.25 mg/cm² + 內部更嚴格規格（如 ≤0.15 mg/cm²）
blocks.en: Specification setting: Per Ph.Eur. 3.3.8 ≤0.25 mg/cm², plus a tighter internal specification (such as ≤0.15 mg/cm²)

blocks.zh: 工藝控制：矽油噴塗量（Spray Weight）+ 固化條件（Baked-on）
blocks.en: Process control: Silicone oil spray weight + curing conditions (baked-on)

blocks.zh: 跨批次一致性：建立矽油量的 SPC 控制圖（Statistical Process Control）
blocks.en: Batch-to-batch consistency: Establish an SPC (statistical process control) chart for the silicone oil amount

blocks.zh: 相容性研究：矽油 + 藥液的長期穩定性（6–24 個月）
blocks.en: Compatibility study: Long-term stability of silicone oil + drug solution (6–24 months)

blocks.zh: 微粒監測：USP 〈787〉/ 〈788〉次可見微粒（<10 μm, <25 μm）
blocks.en: Particle monitoring: USP <787> / <788> subvisible particles (<10 μm, <25 μm)

blocks.zh: 稽核準備最終要點 Final Audit Readiness Tips
blocks.en: Final Audit Readiness Tips

blocks.zh: 文件溯源：每批注射器的 CoA 需保留至產品有效期後至少 1 年（依 EU GMP Annex 16 及 21 CFR 211.68 要求）
blocks.en: Documentation traceability: The CoA for each batch of syringes must be retained for at least 1 year after the product expiry date (per EU GMP Annex 16 and 21 CFR 211.68)

blocks.zh: 供應商審計：每 3 年至少一次對注射器供應商進行實地稽核（On-site Audit），稽核重點包含滅菌製程驗證報告及 EtO 通氣記錄
blocks.en: Supplier audits: Conduct an on-site audit of syringe suppliers at least once every 3 years, with the audit focusing on sterilisation process validation reports and EtO aeration records

blocks.zh: 變更管控：任何材料、供應商、製程變更（包含矽油品牌或塗布工藝）均須通過 CMC Change Notification 流程，並重新評估 Ph.Eur. 3.3.8 相容性
blocks.en: Change control: Any change in material, supplier, or process (including silicone oil brand or siliconisation process) must go through the CMC change notification process, and compatibility with Ph.Eur. 3.3.8 must be re-evaluated

blocks.zh: 趨勢分析：建立 SPC 追蹤矽油含量、EtO 殘留、內毒素等跨批次趨勢，防患於未然
blocks.en: Trend analysis: Establish SPC tracking of batch-to-batch trends in silicone oil content, EtO residue, endotoxin, and so on, to prevent problems before they occur

blocks.zh: 知識管理：確保所有 QC 分析人員熟悉 Ph.Eur. 3.3.8 方法，特別是 GC-MS 的 SST 要求和矽油表面積計算
blocks.en: Knowledge management: Make sure all QC analysts are familiar with the Ph.Eur. 3.3.8 methods, especially the GC-MS SST requirements and the silicone oil surface area calculation
